name: Exp_TrailingStop
summary: This EA is a trailing stop utility that dynamically adjusts stop loss levels to protect profits on existing positions. It does not open trades on its own but manages open positions by moving the stop loss in the direction of profit. The tool supports multiple trailing methods and can be applied to various symbols and timeframes.
summary_zh: 这是一个追踪止损工具EA，动态调整持仓的止损水平以保护利润。它不会自行开仓，而是通过将止损向盈利方向移动来管理已有持仓。支持多种追踪止损方式，可应用于不同品种和周期。
strategy_analysis: 策略概念：该EA是一个追踪止损管理工具，不包含独立的入场策略，而是对已有持仓进行止损跟踪管理。入场条件：EA本身不产生入场信号，仅依赖于用户或其他EA已建立的持仓。出场条件：当价格向有利方向移动时，EA会逐步将止损移动到更接近当前价格的位置，锁定浮动利润；若价格回撤触及新的止损位则平仓。仓位管理：EA不负责开仓或调整仓位大小，仅管理已有订单的止损水平。资金管理：通过追踪止损机制间接实现资金保护，随着利润增长逐步锁定收益，但不涉及直接的资金管理逻辑。该EA支持多种追踪止损算法，如固定点数追踪、百分比追踪、基于ATR的动态追踪等，为交易者提供灵活的风险管理工具。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is that this EA serves as a trailing stop management utility rather than an independent trading strategy. Entry conditions: The EA does not generate entry signals; it relies entirely on positions already opened by the trader or other EAs. Exit conditions: When price moves favorably, the EA progressively moves the stop loss closer to the current price to lock in floating profits; if price retraces to hit the new stop level, the position is closed. Position sizing: The EA does not handle position opening or lot size adjustments; it only manages stop loss levels of existing orders. Money management: Indirect capital protection is achieved through the trailing stop mechanism, which gradually locks in gains as profit grows, but there is no direct money management logic. The EA supports multiple trailing stop algorithms such as fixed-point trailing, percentage-based trailing, and ATR-based dynamic trailing, providing traders with a flexible risk management tool.

parameters.name: TrailingStep
parameters.description: 止损移动最小步长点数
parameters.description_en: Minimum stop loss trailing step in points

parameters.name: UseATR
parameters.description: 是否使用ATR动态追踪止损
parameters.description_en: Use ATR for dynamic trailing stop

parameters.name: ApplyToAllSymbols
parameters.description: 是否应用于所有品种持仓

parameters.name: MagicNumber
parameters.description: EA魔术编号，0表示管理所有订单
parameters.description_en: EA magic number to close (0 for all positions)

pros: 作为纯工具EA，不干扰用户原有的入场策略，可灵活配合任何交易系统使用
支持多种追踪止损方式，包括固定点数和基于ATR的动态追踪，适应不同市场波动环境
通过逐步锁定利润，有效降低盈利交易回撤为亏损的风险，提升整体交易表现
pros_en: As a pure utility EA, it does not interfere with the user's original entry strategy and can flexibly complement any trading system
Supports multiple trailing stop methods including fixed-point and ATR-based dynamic trailing, adapting to different market volatility environments
Effectively reduces the risk of profitable trades turning into losses by gradually locking in profits, improving overall trading performance
cons: 仅管理止损不管理止盈，可能在趋势行情中过早止损出场导致利润未充分释放
缺乏对交易品种点差和滑点的考虑，在高成本品种上可能频繁触发追踪止损
不包含任何入场逻辑，完全依赖外部信号或手动开仓，作为独立EA使用价值有限
cons_en: Only manages stop loss without take profit management, which may cause premature exits in trending markets and fail to capture full profit potential
Lacks consideration for spread and slippage of trading instruments, which may trigger trailing stops frequently on high-cost instruments
Contains no entry logic whatsoever, relying entirely on external signals or manual opening, limiting its standalone value as an EA
improvements: 增加基于市场波动率自适应的追踪止损参数优化机制，避免在低波动期间止损过近或高波动期间止损过远
添加部分平仓功能，当利润达到一定阈值时部分锁定收益，剩余仓位继续追踪趋势
improvements_en: Add an adaptive trailing stop parameter optimization mechanism based on market volatility to avoid stops being too close in low-volatility periods or too far in high-volatility periods
Add partial close functionality to partially lock in profits when a certain threshold is reached while letting the remaining position continue trailing the trend

risk_points: 在剧烈波动的非农或重大新闻事件期间，追踪止损可能因跳空缺口而无法有效执行
若参数设置不当（追踪距离过小），可能因正常市场噪音而频繁止损出局
risk_points_en: During extreme volatility events such as NFP or major news releases, trailing stops may fail to execute effectively due to price gaps
If parameters are set improperly (trailing distance too small), normal market noise may trigger frequent stop-outs
